description: The trailing-twelve-months block: income statement and cash flow summed over the last four reported quarters, with its own derivation note saying exactly which fiscal year and year-to-date columns it was built from (for example 'FY2026 plus first half FY2027 less first half FY2026'). TTM figures are calculated in the record from filed figures, so they have no sec.gov line of their own. Actual dollars (not millions), shares split-adjusted, a foreign issuer's figures in US dollars. Pass `record` for an earlier published record.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_trailing_twelve_months
title: Trailing twelve months
